text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- General Workers' Union complains of deteriorating situation in manufacturing industry. GWU secretary Jack Calamatta said the government was giving too much importance to the country's financial and services sector to the detriment of manufacturing.
- Father and son jailed for 25 years on drug trafficking.
- Magistrate hits out at police for proceeding with weak case over couple accused of stealing a car when it was clear they were innocent.
- Burglars empty two Valletta jewellery shops. Value of haul still being calculated.
- Opposition Nationalist Party accuses Labour Party of smear campaign against Nationalist MPs, linking them to a drug trafficker.
